_meta.indication: Adjunct to diet and maximally tolerated statin therapy for the treatment of adults with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH) or clinical atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), who require additional lowering of LDL-C.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study with an 18-month placebo-controlled treatment phase; 300 mg inclisiran or matching placebo given on a twice-a-year dosing schedule using the same dosing regimen and visit schedules, on a background of maximally tolerated statin therapy.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH) and elevated LDL-C despite maximally tolerated statin therapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: percentage change in LDL-C from baseline to Day 510, and time-adjusted percentage change in LDL-C from baseline after Day 90 up to Day 540.
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-adjusted LS mean difference in percentage change in LDL-C at Day 510 of -49.5% (95% CI -55.0, -44.0), p<.0001.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study with an 18-month placebo-controlled treatment phase; sites only in North America; 300 mg inclisiran or matching placebo given on a twice-a-year dosing schedule using the same dosing regimen and visit schedules.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with clinical ASCVD and elevated LDL-C despite maximally tolerated statin therapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: percentage change in LDL-C from baseline to Day 510, and time-adjusted percentage change in LDL-C from baseline after Day 90 up to Day 540.
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-adjusted LS mean difference in percentage change in LDL-C at Day 510 of -57.6% (95% CI -60.9, -54.4), p<.0001.

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study with an 18-month placebo-controlled treatment phase; sites in Europe and South Africa; 300 mg inclisiran or matching placebo given on a twice-a-year dosing schedule using the same dosing regimen and visit schedules.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with ASCVD or ASCVD-risk equivalents and elevated LDL-C despite maximally tolerated statin therapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Co-primary endpoints: percentage change in LDL-C from baseline to Day 510, and time-adjusted percentage change in LDL-C from baseline after Day 90 up to Day 540.
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-adjusted LS mean difference in percentage change in LDL-C at Day 510 of -47.8% (95% CI -51.1, -44.5), p<.0001.

key_safety: Most notable safety issue was injection site reactions, occurring in 8.2% of inclisiran patients vs 1.8% on placebo. Other common adverse reactions (≥3%) included arthralgia (5.0% vs 4.0%), urinary tract infection (4.4% vs 3.6%), diarrhea (3.9% vs 3.5%), and bronchitis (4.3% vs 2.7%).
target_moa: Inclisiran is a double-stranded small interfering RNA (siRNA) that inhibits hepatic production of PCSK9, increasing recycling and expression of the LDL receptor and lowering circulating LDL-C.

advisory_committee.vote: An Advisory Committee Meeting was not convened for this application.

description.text: Revised the indication to expand LDL-C reduction to adults with hypercholesterolemia including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval sNDA provides for changes to the Leqvio Prescribing Information to change Section 1 *Indications and Usage* to revise the indication to "as an adjunct to diet and exercise to reduce low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in adults with hypercholesterolemia, including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)," as requested in our June 4, 2025, Prior Approval Supplement Request letter. Additional changes were made to other sections of the Prescribing Information to align with the revised indication language.

description.text: Expanded the approved indication to include pediatric patients 12 years and older with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)

citations.quote: Modifications to the Prescribing Information to add results of pediatric study ORION-16 (CKJX839C12301), titled, Two part (double-blind inclisiran versus placebo [Year 1] followed by open-label inclisiran [Year 2]) randomized multicenter study to evaluate safety, tolerability, and efficacy of inclisiran in adolescents (12 to less than 18 years) with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia and elevated LDL-cholesterol, and expand the currently approved indication to include pediatric patients 12 years and older with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH).

summary.text: Leqvio (inclisiran) was submitted as a new molecular entity NDA received December 23, 2019, supported by three randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials (ORION-9, ORION-10, ORION-11); a Complete Response Letter was issued December 18, 2020 for lack of an acceptable drug product facility inspection, and the drug was approved following the Class 2 Complete Response resubmission received July 1, 2021, on the basis of durable, statistically significant LDL-C lowering.

citations.quote: The Applicant, Novartis Pharmaceuticals Corporation, submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) for inclisiran in December 2019, supported primarily by three randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 18-month trials in patients with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH),

A Complete Response Letter (CRL) was issued to the Applicant on December 18, 2020, stating that FDA could not approve the application in its present form due to the lack of an acceptable facility inspection
The Applicant now submits a Class 2 Complete Response Resubmission to address the deficiencies outlined in the CRL.
